# The Git logomark

The picture the `GitVCSPlugin`'s context-menu category wears, fetched by `dev/git-logo/fetch.py` from
`https://git-scm.com/images/logos/downloads/Git-Icon-White.svg` and drawn into
`Git-Icon-White.png` by that script through `rorolala-dev-icons --render`. The picture is
committed, so a build needs neither the network nor the renderer.

The logomark is by Jason Long, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
License. `LICENSE` states the attribution, and the license itself is at
`https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/`.

Nothing here is edited by hand: the SVG is what the address serves, and the PNG is what the
renderer makes of it.
